frozen_rules.rows: preserve all original row identities; no deduplication or relabeling
frozen_rules.preprocessing: fit-only statistics within each inner fit
frozen_rules.active_work: do not modify SMI8, HEPOS40, SOLCTX4, GEO32

priority_proposal.hypothesis: Transparent 2D physicochemical descriptors may add membrane-partitioning information not explicit in existing representations.

split.required: accepted train-only grouped/scaffold OOF manifest for Pgp; reuse if present in source ledger, otherwise partition owner prepares and binds new internal partition

descriptor_spec.version: fixed versioned RDKit implementation; pin exact version at preparation
descriptor_spec.scaling: fit-only z-score for 8 added descriptors; std<1e-8 -> 1; Morgan bits unchanged
exclusions: no external labels or new rows

readout.solver: choose one deterministic solver at preparation and freeze version/solver/tolerance
readout.seeds: do not invent seeds for deterministic solver; fold is primary replication

budget.fits: 6 x K accepted folds; if K=5 then 30 fits (illustrative arithmetic only)

reuse: any accepted Pgp partition if present

primary_outputs: OOF AUROC by fold and equal-fold mean
AP separately named unless official AUPRC contract proven
falsification: No descriptor increment across all three representations weakens the simple 2D membrane-proxy hypothesis.
Gain only in one representation supports an interaction, not universal physicochemical gain.
Overall AUROC gain without repair in low-support/consensus-error groups does not support the proposed mechanism.
No stable representation differences and no group-level pattern closes this finite comparison.
priority_proposal.execution_gate: No execution until partition manifest and original row identity receipt accepted; this proposal does not authorize work.

conditional_alternatives.trigger: Pgp study or task-independent evidence shows representation gaps; herg-specific accepted train-only partition available.
conditional_alternatives.matrix: Morgan/CheM/MiniMol × one fixed L2 logistic readout; only if a persistent consensus-error group remains, add same 8-descriptor view as a second predeclared stage.
conditional_alternatives.stop: No stable representation gap; no extra seed/floor grid.

conditional_alternatives.trigger: Accepted BBB train-only partition; source semantics and logBB cutoff lineage bound.
conditional_alternatives.matrix: Morgan/CheM/MiniMol × fixed same readout, followed conditionally by same 8-descriptor ablation.
conditional_alternatives.stop: No low-support/error relation and no descriptor increment; do not use Pgp inhibitor labels as efflux covariates.

conditional_alternatives.trigger: Accepted inhibition split and assay lineage mapping; AP/AUPRC contract confirmed separately.
conditional_alternatives.matrix: Morgan/CheM/MiniMol × fixed same readout; if source mapping is reliable, train-only source/protocol subgroup analysis, no guessed covariates.
conditional_alternatives.metric: AP unless official AUPRC implementation/source confirmed
conditional_alternatives.stop: No source effect and no representation gap; no F010 repeat.

conditional_alternatives.trigger: Accepted substrate split plus six-publication source lineage.
conditional_alternatives.matrix: Morgan/CheM/MiniMol × fixed same readout; only after persistent error pattern, separately design source-supported site-of-metabolism representation.
conditional_alternatives.metric: AP unless official AUPRC contract confirmed
conditional_alternatives.stop: No weighted BCE/Morgan repeat; no CYP2D6 transfer.

prospective_modules.source_basis: Broccatelli 2011 uses GRID MIF/pharmacophoric features and membrane-partition-related physicochemical properties.
prospective_modules.gate: Only after existing-representation plus descriptor comparison leaves large low-support/consensus-error groups; require immutable code/weights or deterministic coordinate pipeline, protonation/conformer policy, license and producer acceptance.

prospective_modules.source_basis: Wang et al. 2016 reports ensemble of pharmacophore hypotheses integrated with NBC/SVM.
prospective_modules.gate: Only if hERG fixed representation comparison leaves reproducible consensus errors; no paper score substitution.

prospective_modules.source_basis: Ahlström et al. 2007 experimentally studied CYP2C9 substrate/inhibitor/metabolite interactions and LC-MS/MS verification for a distinct 14-compound series.
prospective_modules.gate: Require Carbon-Mangels six-source row lineage and independently admitted frozen module; do not generate labels or infer labels from docking.
